title: Coins and notes
summary: Compare coins and notes without confusing size, pence and pounds.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 compares a physically larger 2p coin with a smaller 5p coin. Q2 reads the two-pound coin. Q3 selects coins worth less than fifty pence. Q4 selects the note worth more than twenty pounds. Q5 reads 20p without confusing pence with pounds. Q6 distinguishes a 5p coin from a five-pound note. Q7 selects two items each worth at least two pounds. Q8 reads a fifty-pound note. Q9 orders mixed pence and pound coins. Q10 rejects the same-numeral trap between 50p and fifty pounds. One question uses a single coin or note to pay an exact price.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy recognises common coin values and the copper and seven-sided coin families. Medium introduces all four Bank of England note values, the two-pound coin and ordering notes. Hard adds new thinking by rejecting physical-size errors, distinguishing pounds from pence when numerals match, and comparing mixed denominations. No coin totals, equivalent combinations or change calculations are introduced.
